applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations shown on electrical plan
findings.comment: Transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan but no dimension callouts or clearance annotations indicate distances from the pads to adjacent buildings (Buildings 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8). Minimum 5-foot clearance from buildings cannot be verified from the submitted documents.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls present around site perimeter and detention pond area
findings.comment: Retaining walls are shown on the grading and site plans, but no dimensions indicate clearance distances from transformer pads to these walls. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations on electrical plan
findings.comment: No fence locations or clearance dimensions from transformer pads are shown on the site plans. Compliance with required 5-foot clearance (for sides with operators/controls) or 3-foot clearance (for sides without operators/controls) cannot be verified without access door orientation and fence location details.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations if clearances less than 5 feet to buildings
findings.comment: No evidence of reduced (3-foot) clearances or Austin Energy Design written approval is provided. If reduced clearances are proposed, documentation of AE Design approval, fire rating verification, confined space confirmation, and vertical clearance to windows/doors/ducts cannot be verified from submitted plans.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations if balconies or overhangs are present
findings.comment: No building elevations or architectural details showing balconies or overhangs above or adjacent to transformer pads are provided. Clearance from balconies/overhangs and absence of coverings directly above pads cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No transformer equipment specifications are provided indicating whether equipment is oil-filled or dry-type. For oil-filled equipment, minimum 12-foot horizontal clearance from windows, doors, or ventilating ducts (when less than 12 feet from grade or less than 5 feet lateral separation) cannot be verified without equipment type specification and building elevation details.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad on west side of site near Building 8
findings.comment: The transformer pad shown near Building 8 on the site plan is positioned adjacent to a 5-foot concrete sidewalk on the western property line. No dimension callout indicates the exact distance from the pad to the back of the sidewalk, preventing verification of the required 2-foot minimum clearance.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No transformer equipment specifications indicate whether equipment is oil-filled. No fire escape locations are identified on the site or building elevation plans. For oil-filled equipment, minimum 20-foot horizontal/radial clearance from fire escapes cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No dimensions or annotations indicate access door orientation or clearance distances from the hot-stick use area (access door side) to open areas or adjacent buildings/structures. The required 10-foot minimum clearance cannot be verified without this information.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to private fire hydrant
findings.comment: One private fire hydrant is shown in the southwest corner of the site. Dimension callouts showing distances from each transformer pad to the fire hydrant are not provided. Compliance with the 5-foot minimum clearance requirement cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Tree locations on landscape plan relative to transformer pads
findings.comment: The landscape plan shows trees marked with designations (SY, PL, M, P) but does not provide species names or identify which trees meet ECM Appendix F utility-compatible requirements. Trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment or 15 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors cannot be verified as utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F.

applicableAreas: Landscape areas adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: Shrub and low-lying vegetation locations are shown on the landscape plan, but clearance distances (10 lateral feet from access door side, 5 lateral feet from other sides) from transformer pads are not dimensioned. Compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment
findings.comment: No root barrier details or specifications are shown on the landscape or detail sheets. Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment cannot be verified as having required root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from equipment).

applicableAreas: Bike rack locations relative to transformer pads
findings.comment: Bike rack locations are not explicitly dimensioned relative to transformer pad locations on the site plan. Compliance with required 5-foot minimum clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Light pole locations relative to transformer pads
findings.comment: Light pole locations are not specifically shown or dimensioned on the site plan or electrical plan. Compliance with required 5-foot minimum clearance from light poles cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Fire lanes on site
findings.comment: Fire lanes are not explicitly marked, dimensioned, or labeled on the fire protection plan. Therefore, 15-foot clearance between transformer pads and designated fire lanes cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Four transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan, but no dimension callouts indicate distances between pads. Compliance with the 5-foot minimum clearance between pads cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Water lines and transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Water lines are shown on the utility tap plan, but no dimensions indicate clearances from transformer pad locations. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Wastewater lines and transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Wastewater lines are shown on the utility tap plan, but no dimension callouts indicate clearances from transformer pad locations. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Storm drain lines and transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Storm drain lines are shown on the utility tap plan, but no dimensions indicate clearances from transformer pad locations. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Underground utilities and transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Underground utilities are shown on the utility tap plan, but no dimension callouts indicate horizontal or vertical clearances from transformer pads. Minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance from other utilities cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to other utility lines
findings.comment: Underground and overhead utilities are shown on the plans, but cross-sectional relationships and vertical stacking cannot be determined. Compliance with prohibition on locating transformer pads or AE facilities over/under other utility lines cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances in access paths with overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas. Cross-sections are required to demonstrate compliance with vertical clearance requirements for transformer access and any overhead obstructions.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations and grading
findings.comment: No transformer equipment specifications indicate whether equipment is oil-filled. Grading plan shows contours but does not explicitly annotate drainage direction from transformer pad locations. For oil-filled equipment, compliance with requirement that liquid flow be directed away from buildings cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations and easement areas
findings.comment: No transformer easements are shown on any plan sheet. Plat depicts drainage easement (NE corner), public utility easement, and wastewater easement, but transformer pad locations relative to these easements cannot be verified. Confirmation that pads are not located in drainage easements, water easements, sewer easements, or electrical easements under overhead lines (without AE Design written approval) cannot be provided.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No transformer easements are depicted on the plat, site plan, electrical plan, or easement exhibit sheets. Transformer easements around pads (required for Austin Energy accessibility) are not shown, and their widths are not specified.

applicableAreas: Electrical routing from transformers to meters
findings.comment: The electrical plan shows routing of underground electric lines from transformer pads to meters, but does not clearly indicate whether 100% of the routing is on private property. Property boundary and easement locations relative to electrical routing cannot be definitively verified from the submitted plans.

applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are provided in the site plan. Pad dimensions, foundation specifications, equipment specifications, and construction details do not match AE Design-approved specifications for the service type (single-phase or three-phase). Specific pad dimensions are not shown on the submitted plans.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads located near parking areas
findings.comment: Transformer pads are shown adjacent to parking areas, but no dimension callouts indicate distances from pads to parking edges. Bollard details (4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts) per AE Design equipment pad details are not shown. Compliance with bollard requirements when pads are within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Proposed customer facilities relative to overhead distribution lines
findings.comment: Overhead distribution lines are shown on the western and southern site boundaries. Building and structure locations relative to these overhead lines cannot be definitively verified as not being installed under or over the conductors due to lack of dimension callouts and utility clearance annotations.
